text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin are<n>here too, and
they run into us right as<n>we're unloading our
luggage.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All three of them are fired up about<n>the Kikuka Sho,
so it's time to let the<n>summer of friendly rivalry
begin!
